title: Fixed Round Guide and Disc Head Paper Trimmer
description: One newly authored complete fixed rotary paper-trimmer-style static exterior. A low whole flat bed with full rear fence and side stop carries two raised end pedestals and one continuous round guide. A genuinely through-bored head sleeve, complete front cheek and raised grip form one displayed traverse carriage. Its supported transverse axle carries an independent thick blunt round disk in front of the bed, with a full upper half guard and visible lower arc; one long low pressure strip remains on the bed. Not the old raised hinged straight cutting-arm table with its handle replaced: the long guide, bored carriage and independent transverse wheel head are all newly authored. Unlike the twin-spindle lying press with a vertical book block and transverse plough feed, there are no deep timber jaws, clamped block, screw spindles or rear plough saddle. No old mesh imported or extracted. Four opaque PBR materials, metres, Z up and horizontally centred whole ground bed. One static prop zero scenes. Blank illustrative exterior only: no actual sharp edge, cutting, paper feeding, carriage travel, measured alignment, clamping, manufacture, ergonomics or hand safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
